services.title: Product design
services.summary: Interface and interaction design grounded in how people actually use the thing.
services.description: We design the screens, states and flows your product needs, then hand over a component library your engineers can build against without guessing. Research is proportional: enough to be sure, never so much that nothing ships.

services.title: Web engineering
services.summary: Fast, accessible, server-rendered websites and applications that hold up under load.
services.description: We build with the boring parts done properly: server rendering for crawlability, real accessibility, sensible caching and a deploy pipeline your team can operate. No framework tourism, and nothing you cannot maintain after we leave.

services.title: Brand identity
services.summary: A visual system that survives contact with a real product, not just a logo sheet.
services.description: Identity work that anticipates where it will actually be used — small on a phone, badly reproduced on a form, alongside copy nobody signed off. You get the marks, the type scale, the palette and the rules for using them.

services.title: Technical audit
services.summary: An honest read on performance, accessibility and search health, with a costed plan.
services.description: We measure what your site does today, explain which problems actually cost you money, and give you a prioritised plan with effort estimates. You can hand the plan to any team — it is not a pitch for more of our time.
